commercial_context.statement: Consumer conversation sentiment is qualitative context for commercial findings. It is not proof of sales impact and does not create a commercial action.

limitations: OAuth credentials were not provided. Unauthenticated JSON is blocked (HTTP 403) and robots.txt disallows crawling (Disallow: /).
YouTube Data API key was not provided. Unauthenticated search returns HTTP 403.
X bearer token was not provided. Search API returns HTTP 401 without authentication.
No officially accessible public-web discussion API is configured. The system does not crawl the public web or bypass robots.txt.
DATA MODE: NO_SOCIAL_DATA. Sentiment is not live social intelligence.
Social & Consumer Intelligence V1 is an external context layer. It does not modify frozen POS or macro agents.
Social observations are never invented. Unavailable sources stay unavailable.
Missing fields stay null. Missing is never converted to zero.
Author identifiers are hashed. Unnecessary personal information is not stored.
Sentiment is not treated as sales causality.
Social intelligence does not create a commercial action or recalculate addressable value or volume.
Future social observations are not used to explain historical POS periods.
HIGH confidence is never assigned from a single post.
Dashboard is not built in this sprint.
Sentiment is conversational tone, not sales causality.
Future observations are excluded from POS-aligned sentiment.
No usable observations — sentiment shares remain missing, not zero.
